title: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) Loss
prompt:
Implement `dpo_loss(policy_chosen_logps, policy_rejected_logps, ref_chosen_logps, ref_rejected_logps, beta=0.1)` for a batch of chosen/rejected response pairs sharing the same prompt within each pair.

Each of the four inputs is a CPU `torch.float32` tensor of shape `(B,)`, with `1 <= B <= 256`. Each entry is the **sum** of natural-log token probabilities over one response, including EOS if present, excluding prompt and padding tokens. These sequence log-probabilities have already been computed; no tokenizer, language model, or training loop is required.

Compared with [Bradley–Terry reward-model training](#/problems/bradley-terry-reward-model-training), DPO replaces learned reward scores with implicit rewards from the policy and a fixed reference:

| Objective | Chosen-minus-rejected preference logit `z` |
| --- | --- |
| BT | `chosen_score - rejected_score` |
| DPO | `beta * ((policy_chosen_logps - ref_chosen_logps) - (policy_rejected_logps - ref_rejected_logps))` |

In both cases, `P(chosen preferred) = sigmoid(z)`. Return the **mean negative log-likelihood**, `mean(-log(sigmoid(z)))`, as a scalar tensor `()`.

**Contract.** Preserve gradients to both policy inputs. Treat both reference inputs as constants, even if they have `requires_grad=True`; their gradients must be absent or zero. Do not modify any inputs. Assume valid, finite log-probabilities in `[-10_000, 0]` and a Python float `0 < beta <= 10`. Keep CPU float32 and remain finite and differentiable throughout this range; extremely small losses and gradients may underflow to zero.

Use stable mathematical primitives such as `logsigmoid`, `softplus`, or `logaddexp`, and PyTorch autograd. Do not call a ready-made DPO trainer or classification loss. Allow about **20 minutes**.

Follow-ups: Why is the initial loss `log(2)` when policy equals reference, even if chosen and rejected have different log-probabilities? Why do we sum response-token log-probabilities rather than average them? How does changing beta affect the preference logit and its gradient?
